title: Choose the visual world for AutoAccounting
question: One direction is presented below, already improved by ideas from the alternatives it beat. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Receiving Desk
options.lineage: accounting-office rubber date stamps: RECEIVED, ENTERED, POSTED
options.thesis: Every document that lands gets stamped through the desk: received, entered, posted. The stamp is the proof the work is done.
options.viewport: Headline left. Right: a live intake tray where dropped documents land as real paper and are hit by a navy RECEIVED date stamp, field annotations, then an emerald POSTED stamp before filing into a ledger slot.
options.risk: Stamps are a strong motif; if used as decoration outside the demo it turns into a costume.

raised.raise: Numbers become the material: amounts and dates set in a mono at true ledger density, in tabular columns, not decorative big stats.
Emerald is strictly reserved for the POSTED / reconciled state, the way red is reserved past zero. Nothing decorative is green.
Hard asymmetry and one idea per section; no rows of three identical cards.

options.label: The Columnar Ledger Book
options.thesis: The whole page is a ruled ledger; documents dropped in become entries written onto it in real time.
options.viewport: A full-width ruled ledger spread with the headline set as its title line, entries posting as you drop documents.
options.risk: The most familiar choice for accounting; it can read like a spreadsheet template.

options.label: Ben-Day Comic Page
options.thesis: Document processing told as a six-panel comic.
options.viewport: A six-panel grid where a receipt fights its way into the books.
options.risk: Bookkeepers do not see themselves here; clashes with the navy/emerald brief.
options.case: Loses on audience and on clarity.
options.kept: Color reserved only for the action state.

options.label: Saul Bass Title Sequence
options.thesis: The product told in timed cut-paper cards.
options.viewport: One full-bleed card per idea, a jittering line tracing the document.
options.risk: Stylish but hides the working demo behind theatre.
options.case: Loses on clarity; no tie to bookkeeping.
options.kept: Hard asymmetry, one idea per section.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Financial data as a strobing barcode field.
options.viewport: A black-and-white field of bars and numbers.
options.risk: Breaks the light, navy and emerald brief; unsettling for financial trust.
options.case: Loses on audience; numbers-as-material is strong.
options.kept: Numbers as material, set at true data density.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.thesis: Client books as a row of meters leaning toward reconciled.
options.viewport: A row of needle meters, one per client.
options.risk: Metaphor needs explaining; it belongs to audio people.
options.kept: Signal color allowed only for one state.

options.label: Paper Automata
options.thesis: A crank turns documents into filed entries.
options.viewport: A cut-paper machine processing a receipt.
options.kept: One continuous mechanism drives every motion.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: Books moving from dark to daylight as they reconcile.
options.viewport: Horizon bands brightening as documents process.
options.risk: Dark ground breaks the light-mode brief.
options.kept: State shown as discrete named phases, never color alone.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fintech SaaS landing page, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and CTA left, product UI right, logo strip, features below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every competitor by design.
